Done. Here's the summary:

## Root Cause

`wrap_bare_frontmatter()` in `crates/liwe/src/markdown.rs` only recognized bare frontmatter if the content started with `"title: "`. Documents starting with any other YAML key (e.g. `created:`, `depends:`, `modified:`) were never wrapped in `---` fences, so pulldown-cmark never parsed them as metadata blocks. The metadata was `None`, and `--meta` filtering returned no results.

## Fix

Replaced the hard-coded `starts_with("title: ")` check with a `looks_like_yaml_key()` function that recognizes any line matching the pattern `key:` or `key: value` (non-empty key, colon, then either end-of-line or space).

## Verification

- All 80 test suites pass (`cargo test` — 0 failures)
- Confirmed the fix works with a manual integration test: bare frontmatter starting with `created:` + `depends: [foo]` now correctly matches `--meta depends=foo`
